title: Missing Check on `loanToken` Safe Transfer Return / Non-Standard ERC20 Behavior in Callbacks
impact: Tokens that return `false` on failure instead of reverting (e.g., USDT, ZRX) can cause silent failures or fund extraction if interactively sequenced through callback hooks. While `SafeTransferLib` handles standard transfers, interactions within external callbacks (`onMorphoSupply`, `onMorphoRepay`) assume token transfers will correctly revert. Furthermore, `repay` updates internal states *before* executing the external callback and transfer, risking read-only or state synchronization anomalies if re-entered.
